name: Tom's Living Room
description: A cozy living room with a worn sofa, a small TV, and a coffee table. A bookshelf lines one wall, filled with paperbacks and a few framed photos. The kitchen area is in the corner with basic cooking supplies.

items.name: TV Remote
items.description: A well-used TV remote control sitting on the coffee table.

items.name: Grocery List
items.description: A handwritten grocery list stuck to the fridge with a magnet. Lists milk, bread, eggs, and canned soup.

conditions.description: A warm and comfortable living space. Natural light comes in through the front window.
